$comment: What is actually in the gym, and WHERE, so a pairing rule has something to check against.
Why this file exists. Until 2026-08-15 an exercise carried id, name, sets, reps, rest, timed,
log, cue, alts and nothing else. There was no equipment field and no station field, so nothing
could ever have caught 'lat pulldown supersetted with dead bug' or 'two machines at once'.
Every superset in program.json paired a station lift with a floor or band exercise somewhere
else, and Silvio found all five of them by standing in the gym holding a phone.
The rule this file makes checkable, in one line:
A SUPERSET MAY OCCUPY AT MOST ONE STATION.
A station is a fixture another member could want: a rack, a bench, a cable stack, one machine,
the preacher seat, the TRX bar, a treadmill. The partner exercise must occupy NO station
(floor, mat, unanchored band, pure bodyweight) AND be performable in the zone you are already
standing in, which is what `floor` on each zone is for.
This rule is not new. It was written into HealthOS/HANDOFF.md on 2026-05-23, after Silvio
rejected a bench-plus-row superset for exactly this reason, as: 'superset partners must be
(a) same equipment, (b) bodyweight/floor partner of the main lift, or (c) adjacent equipment in
arm's reach.' It was prose, nothing executed it, and program.json broke it five times. Per
ENGINEERING.md, a rule that does not execute is decoration. content/gym/validate.mjs executes
this one and fails the build.
Unknowns default to the SAFE direction, not the convenient one. An unverified `floor` is false
and an unverified item is confidence:'unknown', because a false 'you have this' sends him to a
machine that is not there, while a false 'you lack this' only costs a swap.

confidenceLevels.unknown: Not established. Never prescribe as if it exists.

$comment: Occupies NO station, so these carry `station: null` in program.json. They are the only legal
superset partners for a station lift, and a floor-needing one is only legal in a zone whose
`floor` is true.
Dumbbells and kettlebells live here, NOT in `stations`. They are carried away from the rack
and nobody is blocked while you hold them, so two dumbbell exercises pair freely and a
dumbbell exercise pairs freely with a machine. The BENCH is the station in a dumbbell
exercise that uses one.

accessory-boxes.note: Likely to hold the cheapest fixes for the missing categories: slides, med balls, hurdles, agility ladder, ab wheel, jump rope. Every one of those is a portable, no-station, non-floor-hungry way to train the frontal and transverse plane work he is asking for. Worth one look on the next visit, and the single highest-value unknown in this file.
